**Is your idea related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of the problem or friction. Ex. "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you want to happen — what would the block/item/mechanic/creature do, how would it feel?

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative ideas or workarounds you've thought of.

**Gameplay context (optional)**
When in the game would this matter? [early game / building / exploring / ...]

**Additional context**
Add any other context, sketches, or screenshots — references from other games are welcome too.
